annotations.title: Answer transfers between the person’s own accounts

description: Answers the pairs `transfers` lists — **a list in one call**. `transfer`: one transfer between two of the person’s accounts, so neither row is income or spending (the end on an ordinary account counts as money moved, the end on an account with holdings is in no total). `not_a_transfer`: two rows that only looked like one; both stay what they were and are never suggested again. `undecided` takes an answer back. **Dry-runs by default**; the document is copied to a timestamped .bak first.

commit.description: Default false. False previews; true writes.

pairs.description: One entry per pair. Up to 500 in a call.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.
